column3: The Anguish Beyond The Wall
That night---
While everyone was sleeping, late in the night...
Kuh... Shackling me with a 50/50 mixup...! How can she manage that!
Nnnh... Noisy...
The voice is too loud. No way I can fall asleep...
You! You! Youuu!
She clearly exceeded the boundaries of talking to oneself... Grrrr...
That malicious girl!
Ah... She's probably practicing "Siscaly" online with Kuroneko...
Hah?!
Who do you think you are?!
Even quarreling while on the net...!
Who does she think she is?! In-fu-riating!
I have a really bad feeling... Should I fake being asleep?
Hey!
......ZZZZZZ
...Tch, he's asleep. In that case...
I get it... I'm getting up now, I'm getting up...
...What was she going to do to her sleeping brother?!
It's so infuriating!
...W-What is?
I want to kick that black one from our group.
What?!
Come to my room for a moment.
I expected this would happen...
The monitor in Kirino's room is displaying Siscaly.
The decided victor of the two -- the character Kuroneko uses.
I can't deny that this girl has an exceptional reaction time and the ability to accurately read her opponent.
With such skills, it's obvious anyone would lose against her!
And also... you...
Anyway, it pisses me off!
Hah...
So she got thrashed by Kuroneko and was unable to take it, so she's venting her anger by trying to get Kuroneko off the tournament...
Don't be so rash. If Kuroneko is so skillful, that's all the more reasons not to kick her.
But, she actually said about me: "To give up so many frames, is your brain clogged up by all that fashion mongering?"
And also...!
What?
N-Nothing...!
Hmm... I don't know what's going on, but I'm sure it's a matter on a whole other level.
Looks like Kuroneko's words hurt her greatly, her eyes are welling with tears...
What did she do to Kirino? She's definitely taking it too far...
Rest assured, Kirino! You're strong! You must have some confidence!
...Keep quiet.
So this is what you say to a "caring brother who encourages his sister"...
No, it's okay. I don't really mind.
Anyway, I'm gonna kick that black one out...
However, if you say that, you'll end up regretting it, right?
No matter how bad our relationship, an elder brother is still an elder brother.
At the very least, I know what my sister is thinking just by looking at her face.
Well, I...
...I know her skill at games. It bothers me, but if she doesn't take part in the tournament, it will be problematic and besides...
Besides...? What?
...I said it to her...
Said what?
I'm kicking you out of the tournament...
Ouch...
Kirino isn't the kind of sister that would say, "I want to join the tournament with my friends." I know this perfectly well.
She can't accept this kind of situation, but she can't solve the problem herself.
To do something to resolve this, is that the job of an elder brother?
Anyway, you must do something to 【increase our chances of victory】...
Since we've already taken up the challenge, I want to win, no matter what it takes.
Then, just apologizing would be fine.
Me? Isn't she the one at fault?
Who cares who's right or wrong... In a quarrel, both sides have their responsibilities; no one is right or wrong.
You... Do something.
